PB4.derivation: Raw-variable version of P5X L1.6/L1.7, from the operator definitions in cusum_layer1.py / ERROR_ALGEBRA.md sections 1-2. S_0(x) = int_{z not in (l,u)} (z+e) phi(z+e) dz = phi(u+e) - phi(l+e) = E_x[raw_1; tau = 1]. For r >= 1, S_r = (K_z + e K) h_r = E_x[raw_1; tau = 1 + r], with h_r(x) = P_x(tau = r). Hence (K^{i-1} S_{t-i})(x) = E_x[raw_i; tau = t] and F_r = sum_n K^n S_r = E_x[raw_{tau-r}; tau >= r+1]. Splitting Rbar over {tau >= m} and {tau = t < m}: E_{x0}[Rbar] = (1/m) sum_{r<m} F_r(x0) - (1/m) sum_{t<m} sum_{r<t} W_{r,t-r-1}(x0) + sum_{t<m} (1/t) sum_{r<t} W_{r,t-r-1}(x0), with W_{r,j} = K^j S_r. The W coefficient is 1/t - 1/m, which is exactly the frozen table (recomputed: assembly section).
